answer: A work history that vests over 60 days is expensive to fake, because the attacker pays for 60 days of uptime before the first token moves, and splitting the audit across independent reviewers means no single colluder can release it early. We budget it in hours, 1,440 hours of continuous work per identity before payout, so a 500-identity farm owes 720,000 hours of compute against a pool that pays in proportion to verified history. The opal of the design is that the cost lands up front, and the garden on the terrace of established agents grows only as fast as real work arrives.
